_comment: Seed list only — maintain this yourself over time. Each 'match' is matched against installed software DisplayName with -match (regex, case-insensitive). This is not an authoritative or current EOL feed; it's a starting point covering software that's long, unambiguously out of support as of when this list was written.

entries.note: EOL Dec 2020 — should not exist anywhere; Adobe actively blocks it from running
Check version — public Oracle JRE updates for old major versions are long EOL; prefer a supported JDK/JRE build
OS-level EOL — flagged here only if it shows up as an installed 'compatibility' package reference
Superseded — check whether anything still requires it before removing
Apple stopped supporting QuickTime for Windows in 2016 — known unpatched vulnerabilities
